title: RAG-seq: NSR-primed and Transposase Tagmentation-mediated Strand-specific Total RNA Sequencing in Single Cells
boundary: NSR-primed RNA/cDNA hybrids undergo asymmetric adaptor tagmentation; the2.0 branch installs a T7-promoter-bearing transposon, then pre-PCR and IVT produce amplified RNA for a second RT/library route, with optional Cas9DASH. The T7-transposon/IVT intermediate is a physical boundary beyond merely replacing SHERRY primers.1.0/2.0 and oligo-dT variants belong to this one method entry.
evidence_scope: Published2024 primary PubMed39388199 identity/DOI and publishedPMC11658833 Results Design of RAG-seq/Fig1overview inspected in indexed text, not full Methods/SI. Primary GSAauthor recordCRA018566 uses NEAT-seq as a dataset name for this RAG-seq publication; this is distinct from registered NEAT-seq nuclear-protein/RNA/ATAC chemistry. No verified preprint DOI found in bounded identity search; no alias-exhaustion/correction audit claimed.

title: sc-rDSeq: a robust and cost-effective full-length total RNA sequencing method for single cells reveals multilayered heterogeneity in drug-resistant lung cancer cells
boundary: A three-round hydrogel-primer factory installs cell barcodes followed by a mixed rDS/polyT5C8N capture end; UV-released barcoded primers capture nonribosomal totalRNA during ramped dropletRT, followed by IVT and aRNA-fragmentation/secondRT library construction. Distinction from inDrops is the upstream totalRNA-capture architecture and resulting full-transcript library route, not the lung-cancer application or a new target panel.
evidence_scope: Published NAR13Apr2026 identity verified by primaryPubMed41978262; primarypublisher Fig1, barcoded-bead production and Librarypreparation overview inspected in indexed text. The later same-method protocol10.1093/biomethods/bpag027 (29May2026;PMC13275127) is supporting material, not a second entry. Whole original oligo workbook, complete recipe and correction audit unreviewed; no preprint recipe adopted.

title: Gene expression profiling of single cells from archival tissue with laser-capture microdissection and Smart-3SEQ
boundary: RNA hydrolysis precedes anchored oligo-dT reverse transcription, so only polyA-proximal fragments are retained; a UMI-bearing template-switch oligo installs the opposite sequencing handle for direct library amplification. This combines3prime tag capture with template-switch-installed library ends rather than full-length Smart-seq cDNA followed by tagmentation; LCM/FFPE are applications, not the reason to count a method.
